title: Review of c21's swarmalator trade-off: replicates on fresh seed 5; with frequency spread flocks split ~20 per 100 t but circle (median net 1.4 diameters), identical oscillators swim straight (net 19 diameters) and coarsen to 5 flocks with no splits
summary: Re-ran c21's world on fresh seed 5 (1200 particles, T=600) with c21's long.py/motion.py at sw=0.6 and sw=0, plus labkit runs of both (T=400). sw=0.6: 30-50 flocks, 19-31 splits per 120 t after t=120 with merges equal or higher (25-36); 117 flocks live >= 20 t, median path 19.8 but net 1.4 diameters; the split strips (runs/sw06_s5_splits.png) show phase-coherent clumps that separate as their phases drift apart. sw=0: coarsening to 4.9 flocks of ~245 particles, 0-1 splits per 120 t after t=120, median net 19.2 diameters, polar order 0.98. The trade-off reproduces on this seed: turnover and straight travel do not coexist in this world.

observations.finding: runs/sw06.log and sw06_motion.txt: splits 19-31 / merges 25-36 per 120 t after t=120, median net 1.4 diameters over 117 tracks; runs/sw0.log and sw0_motion.txt: 0-1 splits per 120 t after t=120, 4.9 flocks, median net 19.2 diameters; rerun_sw06/particles.png: many small phase-coloured clumps throughout

controls_run.finding: runs/ (sw=0 arm, same seed and duration)

verdicts.limitation: Only the averaged-force arms (sw 0.6 and 0) re-run, one fresh seed; the summed-repulsion and J scans were not re-run, so the 'no size-limited fission with repsum' half rests on c21's seed 0. Flocks at sw=0.6 are near-point clusters (radius 0.6-0.9) below labkit's min area, so labkit's grid segmentation reports 0 splits and 85 nucleations: labkit's lineage metrics are not usable for this world and c21's particle tracker was used instead. 'Necessary' is shown only within this coupling family (phase = heading).
